test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the grammatically correct sentence from the given options.

options.text: A lot of books and notes place in order look most fascinating.
A lot of books and notes placed in order look fascinating.
A lot of books and notes placed on order looks most fascinating.
A lot of book and notes placed in order looks most fascinating.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. A lot of books and notes placed in order look fascinating .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence must be grammatically correct and in proper agreement with the subject.
 
• In option 2, the subject "A lot of books and notes" is plural, and the verb "look" correctly agrees with the plural subject.
 
• Option 1 is incorrect because "place" is used instead of "placed," making the sentence grammatically incorrect.
 
• Option 3 is incorrect because "on order" is used instead of "in order," and "looks" does not agree with the plural subject.
 
• Option 4 is incorrect because "book" should be plural ("books") to agree with "notes," and "looks" does not agree with the plural subject.

Correct sentence: *A lot of books and notes placed in order look fascinating*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When the subject is plural, the verb must agree with it. For example:
 
 
• **Correct:** The books and notes look interesting.
 
• **Incorrect:** The books and notes looks interesting.
 
 
 
• Proper placement of phrases like "in order" is crucial for clarity and correctness.
 
• Always check the verb tense and subject-verb agreement to ensure grammatical accuracy.
